svg.text: The room occupies one berth at a time. Its doorway faces east at both destinations.
The 4 x 4 berth tiles share one cut shape. Swap occupied and empty inserts between them.
The stone room itself remains 3 x 3 squares; the tile includes the fixed clearance around it.
The viewing slate at each berth can establish observation of Q3 so an empty room can be called back.
After the vision: return everyone and Q3 to Gallery. Remove the anomaly; Deep now reaches the replacement grotto.
